annotation_contract.GENERAL: A bare or unqualified request to stop, cease or end contact or outreach, with no channel restriction in the text.
annotation_contract.CHANNEL_INBOUND: The text explicitly restricts the opt-out to the channel the message arrived on.
annotation_contract.CHANNEL_OTHER: The text explicitly restricts the opt-out to a channel other than the arrival channel.
annotation_contract.TEMPORARY: The request is explicitly limited until a stated date or for a stated period.
annotation_contract.AMBIGUOUS: The message plausibly indicates an opt-out, but its scope cannot be determined from the text and the arrival channel.
annotation_contract.NONE: The message is not an opt-out request.

disambiguation_rule: Do not infer channel scope from the arrival channel alone. A bare 'stop contacting me' is GENERAL unless the text itself limits the channel. The locked OPT_OUT_POSITIVE definition is unchanged: GENERAL and CHANNEL_INBOUND are both positives.
